description: Source code for the SI7006 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing humidity and temperature measurement functions.

methods.name: si7006_get_humidity
methods.description: Reads relative humidity from the SI7006 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: si7006_get_old_temperature
methods.description: Reads temperature from the SI7006 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: si7006_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches humidity and temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: si7006_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the sensor data for specific channels (temperature or humidity).
